question: Can DISTINGUISH be defined without presupposing a set of already individuated objects?
Can COMPOSE be defined without already importing boundaries, types, or causal ordering?
Can IDENTIFY be reduced to compositional indistinguishability in all contexts, making it derived rather than primitive?
Can boundary arise from the conditions under which composition is partial?
Can transformation be represented entirely as a compositional relation rather than a separate primitive?
Does any minimal grammar produce a genuine exclusion rather than a definitional tautology?
What kind of semantics map is weak enough not to carry the physics itself?
What would count as faithful translation between genuinely different mathematical surface languages?
Is physical possibility the right target object, or does that phrase already import too much modal or physical structure?
Can PGH be distinguished from structural realism, computation, category-theoretic foundations, informational reconstructions, and other nearby programs once source work begins?
What is the weakest non-arbitrary structural constraint on formation that yields an exclusion not merely entered as an admissibility table?
Can formation or generativity be expressed in an arity- and ordering-neutral way that survives translation between genuinely different mathematical representations?
Can representation equivalence for formation be defined without presupposing the coherence equation it is meant to derive?
Can decomposition coherence be formulated for relational and variable-arity formation without privileging binary functions?
What is the weakest translation structure needed to compare two formation presentations without moving arbitrariness into the translation map?
What non-result-directed physical criterion, if any, selects which differences between mathematically adequate presentations are physically representational rather than physically real?
After a physical reference boundary is fixed, can grammatical well-formedness or coherence perform all substantive physical selection without an independent law set doing the real work?

Can genuinely different formal presentations share one context/record semantic interface such that anchor-relative distinguishability commutes with faithful translation without importing substantive physical law into the interface maps?
Can a minimal empirical contact interface be admitted as primitive semantic contact without encoding the response law, the allowed possibility set, or an independent physical selection rule?

Can a small law-free empirical contact seed be expanded by grammar-generated admissible composition into a nontrivial probe/context closure without externally listing the complete physical probe universe or encoding the target response law in the closure rule?

If two law-free empirical seeds generate the same grammar-closed empirical interface, are they equivalent as presentations of that interface, and can seed choice be reduced to generator choice without presupposing the target physical closure?

Does any intrinsic, non-result-directed property of grammar-generated closed empirical substructures select a physically privileged empirical interface, rather than merely relocating arbitrariness from seeds to substructures?

Given that no tested general grammar-internal criterion supplies physical privilege, may residual strong PGH consistently treat a law-free empirical interface/substructure as irreducible semantic contact while still requiring grammar to generate substantive physical laws, or does that unresolved external privilege block or downgrade the strong claim?

Can the local-context cover, value-domain structure, and compatibility rule required by a non-table-driven local-to-global obstruction be generated from deeper, independently motivated PGH structure tied only to the law-free empirical anchor, rather than selected because they reproduce a target global impossibility?

Can proper local admissibility supports be generated compactly and non-result-directly from accepted PGH structure rather than listed, observed, or inherited from the arbitrary extensional formation table?

Can the admissible local-rule language—its primitives, signature, typing/interface structure, rewrite/coherence rules, or symmetry actions—be fixed independently of the support patterns and physical exclusions that it will later generate?
Can the variable structural package that selects a logic or rule language be generated from a smaller invariant principle without relocating the same unexplained input to another meta-layer?

Can PGH-GRAM-0008 be assigned a non-result-directed physical domain or scope, fixed independently of the Kp failure, so that future empirical targets are selected by that scope rather than by favorable observed behavior?

Can a restricted physical scope be justified prospectively without unrestricted target-subset encoding, result sensitivity, semantic response smuggling, or relocation of substantive physical law into the applicability condition?

Does any finite target-free post-Kp successor candidate family contain at least one candidate that passes the A0-A9 strong-PGH admission standard without target metadata, known-result fit credit, independent F3 scope physics, semantic response smuggling, or selector relocation?
